correctness.rationale: On T_n=L(K_n), a selected vertex subset corresponds to an edge subgraph of K_n. A connected edge component yields a clique in the line graph iff its edges are pairwise incident; that forces a star or a triangle. Maximality excludes two isolated root vertices, and one isolated vertex can coexist only with full triangles, while a two-leaf star can be completed to a triangle and hence is not maximal. Conversely every listed covering partition, and the one-isolated-plus-triangles case, is inclusion-maximal: any added edge creates an induced P3 in its line graph. Exponential set-partition counting assigns edge weight z, triangle z^3, star on k>=4 vertices k choices of center and z^(k−1), with the extra exceptional term. An independent direct brute graph test enumerated every subset of edges of K_n for n=3..6, checking the actual induced-P3 forbidden configuration and insertion-maximality rather than invoking the partition formula; coefficients match M_3=z^3, M_4=3z^2+8z^3, M_5=15z^4, M_6=15z^3+60z^4+6z^5+10z^6. General support/purity follows from the block partition argument.
residual_risks: Verification exhaustive only through n=6 in independent check; proof determines n arbitrary.
Distinct notions maximum cardinality versus inclusion-maximal are not conflated; all labeled root vertices and weighted edge counts retained.
